description: Type hinting stub file providing declarations for functions and types related to PyTorch's autograd compilation within the dynamo subsystem.

methods.name: set_autograd_compiler
methods.description: Configures the autograd compiler instance or clears it if None is provided, with an option to toggle dynamic mode.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears any stored autograd compilation cache.

methods.name: is_cache_empty
methods.description: Checks if the autograd compilation cache is empty.

methods.name: set_verbose_logger
methods.description: Sets a verbose logging function for autograd events, returning success status.

methods.name: call_cpp_tensor_pre_hooks
methods.description: Calls registered pre-hooks on a C++ tensor at the given index, returning the potentially modified tensor.
